title: Organized bands, trading solos and the Riverside session
summary: He contrasts organized with jump-up bands, describes how George Lewis's band supported each soloist, and recalls the Riverside recording without long solos.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom
